{{CharInfobox |color={{orange color}} |corecolor={{orange color light}} |bordercolor={{orange color dark}} |name=Professor Philena Ivy |jname=ウチキド博士 |tmname=Dr. Uchikido |slogan=no |image=Professor Ivy.png |size=230px |caption=Professor Ivy |gender=Female |colors=yes |eyes=Brown |hair=Dark plum |hometown=[[Valencia Island]] |region=[[Orange Islands]] |relatives=Unknown |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Professor}} |game=no |leader=no |anime=yes |epnum=EP083 |epname=Poké Ball Peril |enva=[[Kayzie Rogers]] |java=[[Keiko Han]] }} '''Professor Philena Ivy''' (Japanese: '''ウチキド博士''' ''Dr. Uchikido'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is a [[Pokémon Professor]] who resides on [[Valencia Island]] with her [[Professor Ivy's assistants|three assistants]]. ==History== Professor Ivy was first mentioned in ''[[EP081|Pallet Party Panic]]'' by {{an|Professor Oak}}, who asked {{Ash}} to retrieve a [[GS Ball|mysterious Poké Ball]] Professor Ivy had found but could not be transported directly to the lab or cracked open with her finest equipment. In ''[[EP083|Poké Ball Peril]]'', Ash and {{ashfr}} found Professor Ivy and obtained the GS Ball. Later in the episode, Professor Ivy and a {{p|Raticate}} got sent to the [[Pokémon Center]] because they got in the way of a {{p|Vileplume}} scattering pollen. During these events, {{an|Brock}} fell in love with her and decided to stay with the professor as her {{TP|Professor|assistant}}. Brock continued to stay with her during Ash's [[Orange League]] adventure until ''[[EP115|A Tent Situation]]'', where Ash and {{an|Misty}} met Brock at Ash's home in [[Pallet Town]]. Not only did they part on mysterious terms, but Brock's time spent at her lab had never been fully explained. Whatever happened, speaking Professor Ivy's name around Brock caused him to curl up into a ball and simply state, "Don't mention that name!" The events that caused Brock to be traumatized have been the subject of fan speculation. In ''[[M02|The Power Of One]]'', Professor Ivy was seen with Brock at the lab while contacting Professor Oak about Pokémon disturbances on Valencia Island. After that, she was seen later in a helicopter along with Professor Oak and {{Delia}}, explaining to a news crew about the Pokémon disturbances. The helicopter eventually crash landed on [[Shamouti Island]] with all people inside safe. In ''[[EP115|A Tent Situation]]'', she reappeared in a flashback. Professor Ivy was also accidentally mentioned twice by {{an|Misty}} in the [[EP116|following episode]]. In the English [[dub]] of ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]'', she was mentioned by Brock while flirting with [[Yuko]]. ==Character== Professor Ivy's field of research is in regional differences in Pokémon physiology. Her report on "''Pokémon adaptive variation as a function of regional distribution''" has been published in the {{DL|Magazines in the Pokémon world|Pokémon Researchers Monthly}} magazine. She is considered to be very attractive, but it is noted that her looks do not negate her achievements as a Pokémon researcher.
